note: depth pass 7: L4 例词补充

words.glossEn: the physical features of a stretch of land
words.etymology: 法语 terrain < 拉丁 terrenum「土地」< terra「地」
derivation: terr（土地）+ -ain → 土地的面貌
words.example: The vehicles were built for rough terrain.

words.glossEn: an area of land under a particular control
derivation: terr（土地）+ -it- + -ory（场所）→ 属于某方的土地
words.example: The wolves defend a territory of thirty square kilometres.

words.glossEn: to stick out from a surface
words.etymology: 拉丁 protrudere < pro-（向前）+ trudere（推）
derivation: pro（向前）+ trud（推）+ -e → 向前推出
words.example: A nail protruded from the plank.

words.glossEn: the act of forcing or pushing something out
words.etymology: 拉丁 extrudere 的过去分词 extrusus < ex-（向外）+ trudere（推）
derivation: ex（向外）+ trus（推）+ -ion → 被推出
words.example: The plastic pipe is made by extrusion.

words.glossEn: essential to life or to success
derivation: vit（生命）+ -al → 与生命有关的
words.example: Clean water is vital to the whole plan.

words.glossEn: to bring back to life, use, or strength
words.etymology: 拉丁 revivere < re-（再）+ vivere（活）
derivation: re（再）+ viv（活）+ -e → 再活过来
words.example: A grant revived the town's old theatre.

words.glossEn: relating to the voice; expressing opinions freely
derivation: voc（声音）+ -al → 声音的
words.example: She became a vocal critic of the scheme.

words.glossEn: a strong calling to a particular work
words.etymology: 拉丁 vocatio「召唤」< vocare「呼唤」
derivation: voc（呼唤）+ -ation → 被召唤去做的事
words.example: Teaching was a vocation for him, not a job.

words.glossEn: lasting a long time; long-established
derivation: chron（时间）+ -ic → 拖很久的
words.example: He suffers from chronic back pain.

words.glossEn: the arrangement of events in time order
derivation: chron（时间）+ o + logy（学科）→ 研究时间顺序
words.example: The report sets out a chronology of the accident.

words.glossEn: relating to a large company or group
words.etymology: 拉丁 corporatus < corpus/corporis「身体」→ 结为一个体
derivation: corpor（身体）+ -ate → 组成一个法人实体
words.example: Corporate profits rose for the third year.

words.glossEn: a company recognized as a legal person
derivation: corpor（身体）+ -ation → 结成的法人团体
words.example: The corporation employs forty thousand people.

words.glossEn: relating to the universe
words.etymology: 希腊 kosmikos < kosmos「秩序、宇宙」
derivation: cosm（宇宙、秩序）+ -ic → 宇宙的
words.example: The probe measures cosmic radiation.

words.glossEn: the universe seen as an ordered whole
derivation: cosm（秩序、宇宙）+ -os（名词）→ 有秩序的总体
words.example: Ancient thinkers saw the cosmos as a living order.

words.glossEn: an explosive; something highly volatile
words.glossZh: 炸药；极具冲击力的事物
words.etymology: 希腊 dynamis「力量」+ -ite（矿物、制品）
derivation: dynam（力量）+ -ite → 靠力量起作用的炸药
words.example: The crew used dynamite to clear the boulders.

words.glossEn: a machine that generates electricity; an energetic person
words.etymology: 希腊 dynamis「力量」，dynamo-electric machine 的缩略
derivation: dynam（力量）+ -o → 产生电力的机器
words.example: The bicycle light runs off a small dynamo.

words.glossEn: able to speak or write smoothly and easily
derivation: flu（流）+ -ent → 像水一样流的
words.example: She is fluent in three languages.

words.glossEn: the ability to express oneself smoothly
derivation: flu（流）+ -ency → 流动般的顺畅
words.example: Reading aloud builds fluency.

words.glossEn: relating to young people; immature
derivation: juven（年轻）+ -ile → 年轻人的
words.example: He was tried in a juvenile court.

words.glossEn: to make someone or something look or feel young again
derivation: re（再）+ juven（年轻）+ -ate → 使再年轻
words.example: The new square rejuvenated the old quarter.
